causality_correction: Physically delete outage packets before all radio fits; emit independent positions only when new visible packets arrive; clip the candidate path at its actual handoff endpoint. No heading rule, prior, window, recording or threshold changed. Previous partial folders are invalid pre-fix runs and were stopped before truth scoring.
truth_usage: Scoring only after all trajectories in a requested split have been generated; no true initialization, alignment, selection or calibration.
candidate_information_policy: Window radio is reserved for a conditional reconstruction. All policies share one radio-only p/v reconstruction and physical prior at handoff. It is never replayed as independent raw updates after handoff. Normal-shadow attitude and batch/bank/evidence candidates are alternative conditional estimates from the same window, not likelihood terms added together.
primary_metric: Absolute surveyed-world post-handoff horizontal XY trajectory RMSE, with whole-available-trajectory XY also retained.
